title: A sparse set of components
description:
Build `ComponentStore<T>`, the sparse-set container behind an ECS, for entity ids from 0 up to a maximum given to the constructor.

- `add(entity, component)`: attach the component (replace it if the entity already has one).
- `has(entity)`, `get(entity)` (returns a pointer, or `nullptr` if the entity has none).
- `remove(entity)`: detach it in constant time using swap-and-pop; returns `true` if there was one.
- `size()`, `entities()` (the dense array of entity ids) and `components()` (the dense array of components, same order).

Entity ids outside the range are treated as having no component, and `add` ignores them.
hints: `m_sparse[entity]` holds the index of the entity's component in the dense arrays, or `kNone`. Adding appends to both dense arrays and records the new index.

Removing: take the entity's index and the last index. If they differ, move the last component and the last entity id into the hole, then update the moved entity's `m_sparse` entry to the hole's index. Then pop both arrays and mark the removed entity `kNone`.
